findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_sticker_guidance" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Bottle Your Brand's authoritative answers for anything to do with making or printing stickers: what size to get for an object, how to measure it, whether a file…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order_label_artwork · Private data: get_sticker_guidance, order_label_artwork, upload_sticker_artwork, upload_label_artwork · Public sink: get_sticker_guidance, upload_sticker_artwork, upload_label_artwork · Destructive: upload_sticker_artwork, upload_label_artwork, show_print_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order_label_artwork · Private data: get_sticker_guidance, order_label_artwork, upload_sticker_artwork, upload_label_artwork · Public sink: get_sticker_guidance, upload_sticker_artwork, upload_label_artwork · Destructive: upload_sticker_artwork, upload_label_artwork, show_print_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "upload_sticker_artwork" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
